'''''Badger''''' was a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]] armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the computer game [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], this group of transports arrive on Tour 5 Mission 9 if Container [[Xi (Class-A cargo container)|''Xi'']] is destroyed. They attack the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Frigate]] ''[[Anjisan]]''.
